description: Scenario: participant_identity_set_create_round_trip (tests/participant_identity_smoke_tests.rs:152) verifies the round-trip path but only asserts create["newPi"]["calendarAddress"]. It does NOT assert that create["newPi"]["id"] is absent on the wire. Combined with bd:JMAP-1j9k.1 (Calendar/ParticipantIdentity id field is required and serialized), the test would pass even if the wire payload carries an id the server is forbidden to honor. Consequence: a future contributor who 'fixes' the types to make id Option won't break the test, and the inverse — a regression that brings id back to required — won't be caught. Add the assertion: assert!(create_map["newPi"].get("id").is_none(), "id must not be set by client on creation per RFC 8620 §5.3"). Same gap potentially applies to calendar_event_set_smoke (tests/calendar_smoke_tests.rs:92) — the test fixture deliberately omits id, but the assertion does not enforce its absence on the wire, so the discipline is by-convention rather than by-test.
title: tests/participant_identity_smoke_tests.rs assertion missing id-absence check on create wire payload
